description: Generic drag-and-drop Kanban board with typed items, configurable columns with optional color and WIP limits, optional horizontal swimlanes, custom card/column/swimlane templates, cross-column and cross-lane moves, in-column reordering with a visual drop indicator, and events for card moves and clicks.

parameters.name: ColumnSelector
parameters.description: Function to determine which column an item belongs to.

parameters.name: OnItemMoved
parameters.description: Fires when a card is dragged to a different column or swimlane. The event carries the target position (TargetIndex / TargetBeforeItem) and, when swimlanes are enabled, FromSwimlane / ToSwimlane.

parameters.name: OnItemReordered
parameters.description: Fires when a card is dropped within the same cell (same column and, if enabled, same swimlane) to change its position. When no handler is attached, same-cell drops are a no-op.

parameters.name: OnCardClick
parameters.description: Fires when a card is clicked.

parameters.name: SwimlaneSelector
parameters.description: Groups cards into horizontal swimlanes. Returning null places an item in the trailing "no value" lane. When null the board renders without swimlanes (classic layout).

parameters.name: Swimlanes
parameters.description: Explicit swimlane definitions (order and titles). When null the lanes are derived from SwimlaneSelector in order of first appearance. Ignored when SwimlaneSelector is null.

parameters.name: SwimlanesCollapsible
parameters.description: Whether swimlanes can be collapsed/expanded via a toggle. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: ColumnHeaderTemplate
parameters.description: Custom column header template. When supplied it replaces the default header content (title/count/WIP badge).

parameters.name: EmptyColumnTemplate
parameters.description: Template rendered inside an empty column/cell in place of the default "no items" text.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Whether the kanban board is disabled (prevents drag).

parameters.name: VirtualizeCards
parameters.description: Opt-in vertical card virtualization. When true, each (non-swimlane) column body becomes a fixed-height scroll container that renders only the visible window of cards through Blazor's built-in <Virtualize> — so a column holding thousands of cards stays fast. The card markup/template is unchanged. Defaults to false, which keeps the exact classic @foreach rendering (fully backward compatible).

parameters.name: CardItemSize
parameters.description: Estimated card row height (px) handed to <Virtualize ItemSize> when VirtualizeCards is enabled. Defaults to 88.

examples.title: Kanban board with task cards
examples.code:
@task.Title

@task.Assignee

examples.title: Reorderable board persisting position
examples.code:
<TmKanbanBoard TItem="TaskItem"
               Items="@tasks"
               Columns="@columns"
               ColumnSelector="t => t.Status"
               CardTemplate="RenderCard"
               OnItemMoved="HandleMove"
               OnItemReordered="HandleMove" />

@code {
    void HandleMove(KanbanMoveEvent<TaskItem> e)
    {
        var moved = e.Item with { Status = e.ToColumn };
        tasks.RemoveAll(t => t.Id == e.Item.Id);
        var at = e.TargetBeforeItem is not null
            ? tasks.FindIndex(t => t.Id == e.TargetBeforeItem.Id)
            : tasks.Count;
        tasks.Insert(at < 0 ? tasks.Count : at, moved);
    }
}

examples.title: Swimlanes grouped by assignee
examples.code:
<TmKanbanBoard TItem="TaskItem"
               Items="@tasks"
               Columns="@columns"
               ColumnSelector="t => t.Status"
               SwimlaneSelector="t => string.IsNullOrEmpty(t.Assignee) ? null : t.Assignee"
               CardTemplate="RenderCard"
               OnItemMoved="HandleMove"
               OnItemReordered="HandleReorder" />

@code {
    // e.ToSwimlane is the target assignee (null = unassigned / "no value" lane)
    void HandleMove(KanbanMoveEvent<TaskItem> e)
        => Apply(e, e.Item with { Status = e.ToColumn, Assignee = e.ToSwimlane ?? "" });
}
